title: Exploded bolted steel shear connection
description: Premium Three.js exploded steel shear-connection assembly with I-sections, shear plate, bolts, washers, nuts and geometric fit checks.
learningObjectives: Identify the parts and geometric relationships of a bolted shear-plate connection in an exploded 3D assembly without conflating geometry with strength design.

rights.attribution: Original LearnMat repository contribution. Runtime uses the declared Three.js 0.185.1 peer; no third-party models, textures, fonts, or datasets are embedded.

verification.notes: 0.2.0 replaces the flat renderer with a host-rendered Three.js scene while preserving the analytical/detailing model. Independent engineering, live-browser, screenshot, and accessibility review remain required before approval.

source.reference: Premium 3D rebuild of reserved structures task str-steel-connection; model logic retained from the original repository contribution.
